description:
Divorced, widowed, empty nest, or just done waiting on someone else to fix things? Welcome. You're in the right place.

Every week I take on a home repair or homeowner problem, usually one I've never done before, and figure it out on camera. Mistakes included. Leaky faucets, running toilets, tripped breakers, Wi-Fi problems, smart locks, doorbell cameras and more.

You'll learn how to:
✔ Fix the small stuff yourself and save hundreds
✔ Set up home tech that keeps you safe
✔ Know when to call a pro, and how not to get ripped off
✔ Protect the biggest thing you own

I also work in real estate transactions, so I'll share what I've learned about protecting your home's value.

🔧 New videos every Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday
📋 Grab the free Home Emergency Cheat Sheet: https://beacons.ai/handleditherself

No husband. No handyman. No problem. You've got this.
